DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届けいただいた物について伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'd like to ask about the item you brought in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道で携帯を拾いました。いま鳴っていますが、私が出てよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得携帯の着信への応答可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a mobile phone on the road. It's ringing now, but I don't know whether I should answer it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may answer an incoming call on a found phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いったんそのままにして、拾った場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please leave it as it is for now and tell me where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歩道のベンチの下です。画面の名前から持主を探そうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾得場所と表示名で探そうとした意図を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Under a bench on the sidewalk. I was trying to find the owner from the name on the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where you found it and that you intended to find the owner using the displayed name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前の表示だけでは、持主は確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: A displayed name alone doesn't establish who owns it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で連絡先を開くのはやめます。拾ってから触ったのは外側だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連絡先を開かず触れた範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't open the contacts myself. Since picking it up, I've only touched the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not open the contacts and explain what you have touched. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 落ちていた時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know when it was dropped?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 拾った時刻は覚えています。いつから落ちていたかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾った時刻と落下時刻不明を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I remember when I picked it up. I don't know how long it had been there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the time you picked it up from the unknown time it was dropped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拾った時刻として記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll record that as the time you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。着信の相手への対応も、こちらへお任せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 着信相手への対応を警察に任せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll also leave it to you to deal with the person calling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave handling the incoming caller to the police. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 着信には出ず、携帯は届けられた状態でお預かりします。ご協力ありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We won't answer the call and will keep the phone in the condition in which you handed it in. Thank you for your cooperation. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお荷物を発送されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send this parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 頼まれて持ってきましたが、家族から「送らなくていい」と連絡が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の発送不要連絡を受付前に申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought it at someone's request, but my family has contacted me to say it doesn't need to be sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report your family's message that shipping is unnecessary before the parcel is accepted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ受付前です。発送は保留になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We haven't accepted it yet. Would you like to put shipment on hold?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。先ほどまでの依頼と違うので、念のため本人へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 従来の依頼と異なるため本人への再確認を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. That's different from the request I had until just now, so I'll check with the person concerned to be sure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Offer to check again with the person concerned because this differs from the earlier request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認が済むまで、お荷物はお手元で保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep the parcel with you until you've checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いま聞けました。受取先へ直接持っていくことになったそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認で受取先へ直接渡す予定になったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've just checked. Apparently, they have decided to take it directly to the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that checking with the person concerned confirmed a plan to deliver it directly to the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでは、発送のお手続きは進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: In that case, we won't proceed with the shipping procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。私は持ち帰りますが、家族が取りに来るのをここで待ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送中止後に家族の引取りを待つ場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll take it back, but may I wait here for my family to come and collect it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where you can wait for your family to collect it after cancelling shipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物を窓口に預けることはできません。通行を妨げない所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can't leave the parcel at the counter. Please wait somewhere you won't obstruct people passing through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 預けず自分で持ちます。家族には、窓口ではなく外の待合せ場所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口へ預けず自分で保持し家族と別の合流点を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hold it myself instead of leaving it here. I'll tell my family to meet me outside, rather than at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the parcel yourself without leaving it at the counter and arrange a different meeting point with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お荷物を忘れずお持ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please remember to take your parcel. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードについてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice about your card, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予算を超えて使えてしまいました。家計簿に決めた額で止まると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家計予算超過とカードが止まると思った理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was able to spend more than my budget. I thought spending would stop at the amount I'd set in my household account book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you exceeded your household budget and why you thought the card would stop working. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 家計簿の予算と、カードの利用設定は別のものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your household account book budget and your card's usage settings are separate things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分が書いた額は銀行に設定されていなかったんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予算の記入が銀行設定ではないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the amount I wrote down hadn't been set with the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand that writing down a budget does not set it with the bank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用のカードの発行会社と、設定状況を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check your card issuer and the current settings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 発行会社はこちらの案内にある会社です。銀行の口座があれば全部ここで設定できると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発行会社を示し口座銀行で全設定できる思い違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The issuer is the company listed in this information. I thought having a bank account here meant I could configure everything here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the issuer and explain your mistaken belief that your account's bank could handle all settings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで案内できる範囲と、発行会社への確認事項を分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll separate what we can explain here from what you need to check with the issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。まず今の利用額を確認し、設定変更は発行会社へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用額を確認し設定変更を発行会社へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll first check how much I've spent and consult the issuer about changing the settings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check your spending and consult the issuer about changing settings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更した場合も、家計の管理とは分けて把握してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if you change the settings, please keep track of them separately from your household budgeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。設定変更の確認が済むまで、予算内に自動で止まるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 設定確認前に予算超過が自動停止すると考えない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Until I've confirmed the changed settings, I won't assume spending automatically stops within my budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume automatic prevention of overspending before confirming the settings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 利用額の確認と発行会社への問い合わせを分けて進めてください。ご相談ありがとうございました。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed separately with checking your spending and contacting the issuer. Thank you for coming to discuss this. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの商品についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which product are you asking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この袋だけ数が少ないです。中身が抜けているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 個数の少ない袋を欠品かと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only this bag has fewer pieces. Are some of the contents missing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a bag with fewer pieces has missing contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 個数でなく重さが表示されていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The label shows the weight, rather than the number of pieces.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ重さなら、必ず同じ個数だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同重量は同個数と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the same weight always meant the same number of pieces.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought equal weight meant an equal number of pieces. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つの大きさが違うので、個数も変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The number varies because the individual pieces differ in size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人数分に一つずつ出したいので、重さだけで選ぶと足りないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人一個の配膳目的を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to serve one to each person, so choosing by weight alone might leave me short.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to serve one piece per person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な個数が入っているか、外からご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check from the outside whether there are enough pieces.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋は開けずに数えます。この袋なら人数分あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未開封のまま必要人数分の個数を数える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll count without opening the bag. This one has enough for everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Count enough pieces for everyone without opening the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 重さと大きさも、ご希望に合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do the weight and size also meet your needs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。重さが多い方ではなく、必要な数があるこちらを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 重量優先でなく必要個数を満たす袋を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll buy this one with the number I need, rather than the heavier one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a bag that contains the required number instead of prioritizing weight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お料理の用途に合わせてお選びください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please choose what suits your cooking needs. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子さんたちの遊びで何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened while the children were playing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私のボールを貸しましたが、別の子が自分の物だと思って持って帰りそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貸したボールを別の子が持ち帰りそうだと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lent them my ball, but another child thinks it's theirs and seems about to take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that another child seems about to take home the ball you lent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸したときに、返す約束はしていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: When you lent it, did you agree that it would be returned?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初の子には話しました。途中で加わった子には伝わっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 途中参加者には貸与条件が伝わっていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I told the first child. The child who joined later hasn't been told.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the conditions of the loan weren't communicated to the child who joined later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取り合いになる前に、貸した物だと落ち着いて説明しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before it turns into a struggle over the ball, calmly explain that it was lent to them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 怒鳴らずに説明します。名前が書いてある部分も見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 怒鳴らず所有名と貸与の事実を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll explain without shouting. I'll also show them where my name is written.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the owner's name and explain the loan without shouting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その子の保護者にもお話しできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you also speak to that child's parent or guardian?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近くにいます。子どもだけを責めず、貸した経緯を保護者にも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子どもを責めず保護者にも経緯を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: They're nearby. I'll explain how I lent it to the parent too, without blaming only the child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Share the circumstances with the parent or guardian without blaming the child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返してもらったら、遊びを続けるかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you get it back, please also check whether you will continue playing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は私が帰るので回収します。貸しっぱなしにせず、最後に数を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰宅のため回収し持物数も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm going home today, so I'll collect it. I won't leave things lent out; I'll check the number of my belongings at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Collect it because you're going home and also check the number of your belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、落ち着いてお話しください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please speak calmly. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの紙を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I check the paper you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: これを印刷しました。乗車券だと思って改札へ向かっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約案内を乗車券と思い入場予定だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I printed this. I thought it was a ticket and was heading to the ticket gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the reservation information for a ticket and intended to enter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙には引換えの案内と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The paper says it contains instructions for exchanging it for a ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 印刷できたら乗れると思っていました。引換えはまだしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 引換案内だと知り未引換を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could board once I'd printed it. I haven't exchanged it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you now know it is an exchange notice and haven't exchanged it yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用する予約の内容と、必要な引換えを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your reservation details and the exchange you need to make.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予約番号はここです。人に見えるよう広げず、窓口でお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約番号を周囲へ広げず窓口で提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The reservation number is here. I'll show it at the counter without spreading it out for other people to see.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present the reservation number at the counter without displaying it to people around you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人様の確認に必要な物もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll also explain what you need for identity verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 必要な物が足りなければ、持ってきた紙だけで無理に入場しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要物不足でも紙だけで入場しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I'm missing anything required, I won't try to force my way in using only the paper I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to enter with only the paper even if required items are missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出発時刻も確認して、対応をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check your departure time and discuss what to do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時刻が近いので、先に引換え方法を聞きます。改札にはまだ行きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出発時刻が近いと示し引換手続きを優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Departure is soon, so I'll ask how to exchange it first. I won't go to the gates yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that departure is soon and prioritize the exchange procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 出発時刻が近いことも引換え担当へ伝えます。予約の案内を乗車券として改札で使わないようお願いします。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll also tell the staff handling exchanges that your departure time is approaching. Please don't use the reservation information as a ticket at the gates. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 番号をお呼びしていましたが、お聞きになれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: We were calling your number. Were you able to hear it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 音が聞き取りにくく、自分の番号か分かりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 呼出音が聞き取れず自分の順番が不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was hard to make out the sound, so I couldn't tell whether it was my number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you couldn't make out the call and don't know whether it is your turn. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの番号札を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your numbered ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。大きな声で何度も呼ぶより、目で分かる方法が助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号札を示し声より視覚案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. A way of seeing it would help me more than repeated loud calls.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your numbered ticket and request visual guidance instead of spoken calls. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、番号表示の見える席をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then shall I show you to a seat where you can see the number display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。表示が切り替わるときに、窓口の場所も分かるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示の見える席を希望し窓口位置も分かるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I'd like to check whether I'll also be able to tell where the counter is when the display changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a seat with a view of the display and ask whether you can also identify the counter's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号と窓口が並んで表示されます。こちらから見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The number and counter are displayed side by side. Can you see them from here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見えます。ただ、ほかの案内も出るので、自分の番号の欄を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見える表示内で自分の番号を見る欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. But other information appears too, so please show me which section to watch for my number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which section of the visible display shows your number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この欄です。案内が分からなければ、こちらの係へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This section. If you don't understand the information, please tell this member of staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。番号札を手元に置き、表示で番号と窓口を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札と表示の番号と窓口を照合すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll keep my ticket with me and match the number and counter on the display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will match the ticket with the displayed number and counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示の番号と窓口を番号札で照合してお待ちください。聞き取れなかったときは係へお知らせいただけます。では、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait while checking the displayed number and counter against your ticket. You can tell a member of staff whenever you couldn't hear the call. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族への連絡で、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about contacting your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 退院の見込みを確定日だと思い、家族に迎えを頼んでしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退院見込みを確定日として家族に迎え依頼したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took the estimated discharge date as definite and have already asked my family to pick me up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you treated the estimated discharge date as confirmed and asked your family to collect you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ確定した案内ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It hasn't been confirmed yet, has it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。家族が休みを取る前に、予定ということを伝え直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の休暇決定前に予定だと訂正したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I'd like to correct that and tell them it's only a plan before they take time off work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Offer to correct the information to a tentative plan before your family decides on leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在分かっていることを、担当にも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also check with the staff in charge what is currently known.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。日付が未確定なのか、迎えの時間だけ未定なのか分けて知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日付と時刻の未確定範囲を区別して尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I'd like to distinguish whether the date itself is unconfirmed or only the pickup time is undecided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask separately whether the date or the time remains unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日付を含め、担当の案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the information from the staff in charge, including the date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、今は日付を約束しません。家族には決まってから改めて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日付を約束せず確定後に再連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't promise a date for now. I'll contact my family again once it's decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide not to promise a date and to contact your family again once it is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お迎えについて確認したい条件はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are there any pickup arrangements you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族が遠方なので、確定後どこへ連絡すればよいかも伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 遠方の迎えのため確定後の連絡先も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My family lives far away, so I'd also like to ask whom to contact once it's confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check whom to contact after confirmation because your family will travel from far away to collect you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 退院日と、お迎えの連絡先を確認したいご希望を担当へ引き継ぎます。ご家族へは確定後に改めてご連絡ください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on your wish to confirm the discharge date and the contact for pickup arrangements to the staff in charge. Please contact your family again after confirmation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご一緒の方も、現場をご覧になったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did the person with you also witness what happened at the scene?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。友人は日本語の補助に来ました。現場にはいませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行友人は言語補助で現場の目撃者ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. My friend came to help me with Japanese. They weren't at the scene.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your accompanying friend is providing language help and did not witness the scene. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、実際に見た方から状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then we'll ask the person who actually saw it to describe the situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私が見たことを話します。友人には分からない言葉の意味だけ手伝ってもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の観察を本人から話し友人に意味の補助を頼むと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll explain what I saw. I'd like my friend to help only with the meanings of words I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish giving your own observations yourself from asking your friend for help with meanings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 補助の方の推測と、ご本人の説明が混ざらないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's make sure the helper's guesses don't become mixed with your own account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。聞き返すときも私から質問します。友人の「たぶん」を私の話にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 聞返しは自分で質問し友人の推測を事実にしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll ask questions myself when I need something repeated. I won't present my friend's 'probably' as my own account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask follow-up questions yourself and won't turn your friend's guesses into facts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明で分からない言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any words in the explanation you don't understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この記録の言葉です。意味が分からないまま、そうですとは答えたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録する言葉の意味を理解するまで用語説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: This word in the record. I don't want to say 'yes, that's right' without knowing what it means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request an explanation of the terminology until you understand the meaning of the words being recorded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録する前に意味を説明し、ご本人に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before recording it, we'll explain the meaning and confirm it with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。自分が話したことと違えば訂正を頼みます。友人が見た事実として記録しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録の本人発話と推測混入を確認し違えば訂正を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. If it differs from what I said, I'll ask for a correction. Please don't record it as something my friend witnessed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that the record reflects your own statements without added guesses, and request corrections if it differs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご友人は用語の補助で、目撃者ではないことを担当へ伝えます。記録の意味はご本人に確認してから進めます。受付からは以上です。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the staff in charge that your friend is helping with terminology and is not a witness. We'll confirm the meaning of the record with you before proceeding. That's all from reception. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 中には何を入れてありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書類です。あ、それと小さな付属品も入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 書類に加え部品を同封したと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Documents. Oh, and I also put in a small accessory part.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your statement to say you enclosed a part as well as documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類だけではないのですね。どんな付属品でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it isn't just documents. What sort of accessory is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: プラスチックの部品です。封筒に入れば、全部書類扱いだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部品の材質と封筒なら書類という思い違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: A plastic part. I thought everything that fitted in an envelope was treated as documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the part's material and your mistaken belief that anything in an envelope counts as documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 形だけでなく、内容と大きさを確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the contents and dimensions, as well as the shape, before advising you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、部品も含めて説明します。紙に挟んであるので、厚みがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙に挟んだ部品と厚みを含めて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll describe the part too. It's between sheets of paper, so the package has some thickness.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the part between the papers, including the resulting thickness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 梱包が内容に合うかも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's also check whether the packaging suits the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書類を折らずに、部品の角も保護したいです。方法を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類を折らず部品角も保護する梱包を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to protect the corners of the part without folding the documents. Can I ask you about how to do that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about packaging that protects the part's corners without folding the documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取扱いと梱包について、確認できる範囲をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain what we can verify about handling and packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。封筒のまま送ることにこだわらず、必要なら包み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒に固執せず必要なら包み直すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I won't insist on sending it in the envelope; I'll repackage it if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to insist on an envelope and to repackage if necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 部品の角と書類を保護したいご希望を、梱包の担当へ引き継ぎます。必要な包み直しは案内を聞いてからお決めください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the packaging staff that you want to protect the part's corners and the documents. Please listen to their guidance before deciding on any necessary repackaging. Goodbye.
